text: A car travels 150 km at a constant speed of 60 km/h. Parking then takes 15 minutes. What is the total elapsed time in hours?
A 1500 W heater runs for 2 hours. Electricity costs 0.20 dollars per kWh. What is the electricity cost in dollars?
An aluminium block has volume 0.002 m^3 and density 2700 kg/m^3. Aluminium costs 4 dollars per kg. What is the material cost in dollars?
A car uses 6 litres of fuel per 100 km and travels 250 km. Fuel costs 1.60 dollars per litre. What is the total fuel cost in dollars?
A 10 ohm resistor has 5 A of current for 60 seconds. What is the energy dissipated in joules?
A solar panel produces 400 W for 5 hours. A battery stores 80% of this energy. What is the stored energy in kWh?
A rectangular tank is 2 m long, 1 m wide and 0.5 m deep. A pump supplies 20 litres per minute. How many minutes does it take to fill the empty tank?
Three workers each work 8 hours at 20 dollars per hour. Materials cost 100 dollars. What is the total project cost in dollars?
Who wrote Leaves of Grass, and how many years after the author was born was the first edition published?
Earth takes 365.25 days to orbit the Sun and Mars takes 687 days. How many Earth years are 3 Mars years?
A battery initially stores 5 kWh. A 500 W appliance runs for 3 hours. Ignoring losses, how much energy remains in the battery in kWh?
A heater uses 2 kWh of electricity. How much useful heat does it produce?
